The release announcement is cited only for the tactic separation it actually reports, which is what the cited note supports.

critical_resolutions.resolution: Split the sourcing: the tactic separation and its date are attributed to the announcement as reported; the rename-in-place and the T1562 arity are attributed to our reading of the bundles, with a forward reference to Section 6.2.
